column1: # THE REGISTER ITSELF, ACT BY ACT — not the index.
# Rosario cathedral baptisms, LIBRO 24. FamilySearch film 004098792, waypoint "Bautismos 1881-1882".
# Read 10 September 2026 by the DeepZoom tile method.
# WHY: every null this archive holds for Rosario rests on a TYPESCRIPT INDEX compiled later from the
# registers. Whether that typescript is complete has never been tested. This is the test.
# METHOD: each opening carries about eight acts, and every act has the child's NAME WRITTEN IN THE
# MARGIN. At level 12, 42% scale, a whole opening fits one screen with every margin legible. So the
# margins were read for all 183 acts in the span - not skimmed, read.
# CALIBRATION, useful to anyone continuing: Rosario cathedral baptised 112 children in January 1882 and
# 122 in February - about four a day. Acts run continuously; the year begins at act 1 and page 362.
# *** RESOLUTION - READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING ANY ROW. ***
# The first pass (10 Sep 2026) read whole openings at level 12, 42% scale. That was NOT good enough: at
# that size "Timoteo Lucero" was read as "Armando Sara" - both words wrong, and an L-surname missed.
# Every row below has therefore been RE-READ from the MARGIN STRIPS at level 13 (the maximum), where the
# names are unambiguous. The method: render tile columns 0-3 and 9-12 side by side - the two margin
# columns of the opening - in one image. One screenshot per opening, every name legible.
# The conclusion did not change. Many individual readings did, and the corrected ones are below.
# *** RESULT, AFTER THE SECOND PASS OF 13 SEPTEMBER 2026: ***
# *** NO LERENA IN ANY ACT FROM 1 FEBRUARY TO 22 JULY 1882 - SEVEN HUNDRED AND FIFTY BAPTISMS. ***
# Pablo Armando was born 22 February 1882. This is the first two-thirds of his birth year, read act by
# act from the register itself rather than from the 1945 index - which is the whole point: it tests
# whether the index is complete. Across 750 consecutive acts the index and the register AGREE.

column1: # *** WHERE THIS SWEEP NOW STANDS, 13 September 2026. ***
# The register of Rosario cathedral has been read ACT BY ACT, from the margins at full resolution,
# from ACT 113 (1 February 1882) to ACT 862 (22 July 1882) - SEVEN HUNDRED AND FIFTY BAPTISMS,
# the first two-thirds of the year in which Pablo Armando Lerena was born on 22 February.
# *** THERE IS NO LERENA IN ANY OF THEM, IN ANY SPELLING. ***
# Five frames in the April-July stretch are duplicate exposures (257, 264, 300) or pages covered by
# loose certificates laid on the book and read from the facing frame (284/285, 301/302). Two near
# misses were logged and resolved: ARMANDO JUAN ROUILLON (act 546, born 26 April 1882) and
# PABLO JACINTO GAUNA (act 827, 11 July 1882) - the second checked at full magnification in case the
# surname read LARENA. It does not.
# WHAT THIS TESTS, AND IT IS THE POINT OF THE WHOLE EXERCISE: every Rosario null this archive holds
# rests on a TYPESCRIPT INDEX compiled in 1945 from these registers. If the index were incomplete,
# the register would show a Lerena the index had missed. Across 750 consecutive acts it does not.
# The index and the register AGREE. He is not there, and the index is not the reason.
# TO CONTINUE: acts 863 onward are in the next waypoint, "Bautismos 1882-1883".
# *** THIRD PASS, 13 September 2026 - INTO THE NEXT VOLUME. ***
# Waypoint "Bautismos 1882-1883", 287 images. It OVERLAPS the previous volume: it opens at act 851,
# where the last one ran to 862. Six acts to an opening here, not eight; margins wide and legible.
